We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have no SMILES given. We need to infer from NMR or IR? The task likely expects using IR spectra to detect carbonyl stretch. Use ir_spectra tool to get IR, then count C=O peaks (~1700 cm-1). Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). But easiest: IR.

We need to call ir_spectra.
